text: [issue by Mazyka715] ### Context sable wants 1.0.6 flywheel but i cant download it on neoforge 1.21.1 mods: ### Crash Report without flywheel 1.0.4: https://mclo.gs/P52syHn with flywheel 1.0.4: https://mclo.gs/ZBIu0DT [comment by VoidLeech (collaborator)] This isn't the Aeronautics issue tracker. Idk why you're adding some `flywheel-1.0.x` jar that internally is Flywheel 1.0.4 to your mods folder or where you're even getting that from but you obviously shouldn't do that. Your actual issue is that Sable isn't compatible with the Sodium alpha.
